using System.Numerics;

namespace Blend
{
    internal static partial class PorterDuff
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Returns the result of the "MultiplySrcAtop" compositing equation.
        /// </summary>
        public static global::System.Numerics.Vector4 MultiplySrcAtop(global::System.Numerics.Vector4 backdrop, global::System.Numerics.Vector4 source, float opacity)
        {
            source = global::Blend.PorterDuff.WithW(source, source * opacity);

            return global::Blend.PorterDuff.Atop(backdrop, source, global::Blend.PorterDuff.Multiply(backdrop, source));
        }
    }
